question: Terms in any account, scientific or otherwise, are names that point to underlying processes. What a study observes is those processes, not the names. Setting aside whether this has been done yet, could the key terms in this account be connected directly to observations of the processes they point to, through behavioral, physiological or first-person methods, without first translating them into the terms of another account? Rate it from 1 (the terms could not be connected to any observations) to 7 (the terms could readily be connected to observations), then give two sentences explaining your rating.
